credential_manager.text: Stores the encrypted account key in Windows Credential Manager so the app can unlock without asking for a password.

multi_instance.text: Allows more than one Roblox client to run at the same time. Roblox anti-cheat behavior can change, so use this at your own risk.

kill_background_roblox.text: Closes idle Roblox tray processes before launching so they do not block another client.

auto_arrange_windows.text: Automatically places Roblox windows into the selected monitor layout after launch.

target_display.text: Chooses which monitor receives automatically arranged Roblox windows.

grid_layout.text: Chooses how arranged Roblox windows are distributed across the target display.

layout_columns.text: Sets the number of columns used by the fixed or custom grid layout.

layout_rows.text: Sets the number of rows used by the fixed or custom grid layout.

layout_dimensions.text: Sets the columns and rows used by a custom grid layout.

window_padding.text: Sets the gap, in pixels, between tiled Roblox windows and the display edges.

rename_windows.text: Changes Roblox window titles to include the account alias, making tiled clients easier to identify.

launch_delay.text: Adds a minimum pause between account launches to reduce Roblox rate limiting.

privacy_mode.text: Clears RobloxCookies.dat before launching to reduce account association through stored browser cookies.

anonymize_names.text: Replaces account names with generic labels in the app and window titles.

utility_enabled.text: Shows the Utility tab, which contains optional tools such as Assets.

developer_options.text: Shows the Assets tab inside Utility. Uploading creates permanent, publicly moderated Roblox assets.

roblox_player_path.text: The RobloxPlayerBeta.exe file to launch directly. Leave empty to detect the installed player automatically.

encryption_password.text: A master password protects the account store and is required each time RM starts. Without it, the accounts cannot be recovered.
